# Red Rocks Exotic Reptiles

> Colorado reptile store and ethical breeder offering captive-bred reptiles, feeder insects, reptile supplies, aquatic plants, entomology art, and breeder-backed care information.

## Official information

- Website: https://rrereptiles.com/
- Shop: https://rrereptiles.com/shop/
- Care guides: https://rrereptiles.com/care-guides/
- Contact: https://rrereptiles.com/contact.html
- Shipping and local pickup: https://rrereptiles.com/shipping.html
- Email: rrereptiles@gmail.com
- Phone: 970-400-1278
- Service area: Colorado and the United States for eligible shippable products
- Local pickup: By prior arrangement; no public walk-in storefront

## Shop categories

- [Reptiles](https://rrereptiles.com/shop/reptiles.html): Browse available captive-bred geckos, skinks, lizards, and snakes from Red Rocks Exotic Reptiles, a Colorado reptile breeder and online store.
- [Reptile Supplies](https://rrereptiles.com/shop/reptile-supplies.html): Shop reptile husbandry supplies, custom hides, feeding ledges, bowls, supplements, enclosure accessories, and 3D-printed reptile products.
- [Feeder Insects](https://rrereptiles.com/shop/feeders.html): Check local availability for crickets, mealworms, superworms, dubia roaches, fruit fly cultures, isopods, and other reptile feeders. Local pickup only.
- [Aquatic Plants](https://rrereptiles.com/shop/aquatic-plants.html): Shop fully submerged-grown freshwater aquarium plants, including swords, mosses, stem plants, floaters, and other aquatic plants from Colorado.
- [Entomology Art](https://rrereptiles.com/shop/entomology-art.html): Browse handcrafted pinned insect displays, floating frames, shadow boxes, and custom entomology art from Red Rocks Exotic Reptiles.

Product availability and prices can change. Use each product page and the secure storefront as the current source. Care guides are general educational references and are not veterinary diagnosis.
